title: World's largest banks, by total assets
source_name: The world's largest banks by assets, 2026
definition: Total assets as reported (as-reported basis, not adjusted for differing accounting standards such as US GAAP vs IFRS), ranked among the world's 100 largest commercial banks, as of Dec. 31, 2025, adjusted on a best-efforts basis for pending/completed M&A
notes: Rank and country columns included in staging file for reference; only bank name and total assets (US$bn) are merged. Full 100-bank table extracted from Wikipedia's 'List of largest banks' article (fetched via MediaWiki API, not hand-transcribed), which reproduces the S&P Global Market Intelligence ranking; verified against S&P Global's own published article text, which confirms rank-1 Industrial and Commercial Bank of China at $7.646 trillion (matches staged value of 7645.80) and a Dec. 31, 2025 data date.

title: Democracy Index
source_name: Democracy Index 2025 (via Wikipedia compilation of EIU report data)
definition: Democracy Index overall score, 0-10 scale, based on electoral process and pluralism, functioning of government, political participation, political culture, and civil liberties
notes: EIU's own 2025 report dropped its free country-by-country appendix (paywalled); values extracted from Wikipedia's 'The Economist Democracy Index' article (List by country table, 2025 column), which compiles the same EIU-published figures with citation. Hong Kong dropped (China has its own separate row from the same source).

title: Total Nobel Prize wins
source_name: Nobel Prize API v2.1, laureates endpoint
definition: Total number of Nobel Prizes (all six categories: Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Literature, Peace, Economic Sciences) awarded to individual laureates, tallied by country of birth (modern-day country, i.e. historical birthplaces mapped to today's borders). Excludes prizes awarded to organizations, which have no country of birth.
notes: Faroe Islands and Guadeloupe births merged into Denmark and France respectively (constituent parts of those states); Scotland and Northern Ireland births merged into United Kingdom. 3 of 990 individual laureates (Abdulrazak Gurnah 2021 Literature, James A. Robinson 2024 Economics, John M. Martinis 2025 Physics) have no birthplace recorded in the Nobel API and are excluded, so totals may undercount by 1 prize each for their (unknown) birth countries.

title: Total population
source_name: Population, total (SP.POP.TOTL); Household registration population statistics; Vatican City State population
publisher: World Bank; Ministry of the Interior (R.O.C. Taiwan); Vatican City State
definition: Total population, mid-year estimate, all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship
notes: API: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?format=json&mrnev=1&per_page=400. Taiwan and Vatican City are not covered by the World Bank series; filled from their own national statistical authorities (Taiwan: MOI household-registration total population, cited via Taipei Times 2025-06-11 reporting May 2025 MOI figures; Vatican City: official state website, residents incl. citizens and non-citizens). Both report total resident population counts comparable to the World Bank's definition, so combining is moderate-level: same measure (total residents), closest available data year per place. Simplification: Vatican City's figure is dated 2024-12-31 on the Vatican's own site (its most current published snapshot as of this column's compilation) and is treated here as the 2025 data point -- close enough (one day) to count as current, and Vatican City had not yet published a 2025 update as of 2026-08-08.

title: International tourist arrivals
source_name: UN Tourism Statistics Database (via Our World in Data, 'Arrivals of Tourists from Abroad')
publisher: UN Tourism (via Our World in Data)
definition: Number of trips by visitors who arrive from abroad and stay overnight (International Recommendations for Tourism Statistics 2008 standard); most recent year reported per country, so vintage varies by country
notes: API: https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/international-tourist-trips.csv?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=true . Checked World Bank's own mirror (ST.INT.ARVL) first and confirmed it is frozen/stale (spot-checked USA, FRA, CHN, DEU, GBR, ESP via https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/ST.INT.ARVL -- no country had any non-null value after 2020), so used UN Tourism's own Inbound Tourism database (republished by Our World in Data with original citation) instead. Dependencies/territories that this source reports as their own distinct entry alongside a separate parent-country entry (Hong Kong, Macao, Puerto Rico, Bermuda, Aruba, Curacao, Sint Maarten, Guam, American Samoa, N. Mariana Is., US/British Virgin Is., Cayman Is., Anguilla, Montserrat, Turks and Caicos, Cook Is., Niue, New Caledonia, French Polynesia, Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana, Reunion) are left separate rather than summed into the parent, per project default: summing would invent a total the source never published, and would mix vintages (e.g. mainland France's own latest year is 2021, while its overseas departments run 2018-2024). The Netherlands' BES special municipalities (Bonaire, Saba, Sint Eustatius) are likewise excluded: last available year is 2010 (16 years stale) and combined volume (~90-100k arrivals) is immaterial next to the Netherlands' own 16M. [manual prune 2026-08-08: 61 rows whose per-country latest-available year was before 2022 were cleared from data/countries.csv per user request, dropping coverage from 182/197 to 121/197 and the date span from 2000-2024 to 2022-2024; per-row years re-derived from the source API's full time series (max year with a non-null value per ISO3 code)]

title: Total population
source_name: Vintage 2025 Population Estimates, State Population Totals and Components of Change
definition: Estimated resident population of each state and the District of Columbia as of July 1, 2025 (Vintage 2025 postcensal population estimate)
notes: Downloaded NST-EST2025-ALLDATA.csv from https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/datasets/2020-2025/state/totals/NST-EST2025-ALLDATA.csv, filtered to SUMLEV=040 (state level), POPESTIMATE2025 column; Puerto Rico row present in source but excluded (not a state).
